thread:
keira_sales: Heads-up: Prospect 'TideGate' requires strict EU+CA residency for inference, logs, keys, and telemetry. They want hosted if possible but zero cross-border egress in any path. Need uplift, timeline, and answers for the security questionnaire (section 4.2 on subprocessors).

mohit_engineer: We can do tenant sticky routing with primary region + cold-standby regional pair. Important: KV/prefix cache and model kernels stay in-region when pinned. Control-plane metadata (job ids, billing meta) is global today; to lock that down we need Private or control-plane sharding (engineering project).

ana_privsec: Legal will ask for a subprocessor inventory scoped to eu/ca (including CDN/monitoring providers) and confirmation that audit logs are stored in-region. Also they want BYO-KMS and a runbook proving keys never leave the region. Can hosted guarantee that today?

mohit_engineer: BYO-KMS supported for AWS/GCP/Azure CMKs. If we keep the control plane global, key policies must allow our global control-plane principal to call envelope decrypt, or we deploy a regional key-proxy so envelope ops never cross borders. Proxy is doable but adds ops work.

rory_ops: Ops notes: options:
- Hosted pinned + no-fallback: fastest, but risk of unserved requests if regional capacity dips. Reserve headroom to reduce risk.
- Hosted pinned + weighted failover to a paired region with encryption-only path (if customer permits limited egress for envelope ops).
- Dedicated / Private for full locality.

If they want absolute zero cross-border, we recommend Dedicated or Private. ETA for hosted pinned + regional pools: 10 business days. Add KMS proxy: +5 days. Private: 4-6 weeks.

keira_sales: They also asked about egress cost accounting and whether we can attribute egress to the tenant for billing & show matrices in the SOW.

mohit_engineer: We can tag egress flows per-tenant and provide a per-tenant egress report. Note: regional pinned deployments reduce cross-region egress but may increase intra-region compute cost; rough uplift estimate: +22% on hosted usage if we lock to EU/CA (includes reserved headroom). Dedicated pricing will be custom but often lowers per-unit by ~8% relative to hard-pin hosted.

ana_privsec: For the security questionnaire: I'll prepare a one-page attestation listing subprocessors (AWS eu-west-1, GCP europe-west2, Azure canada-central, FastCDN-EU, Loghaus EU) and confirm regional log sinks and retention controls. Need ops to confirm SSO/metrics telemetry exclusion for the tenant.

rory_ops: We can exclude tenant-level telemetry from global aggregation and keep sampled traces in-region; full in-region-only metrics ingestion requires pipeline tweak (ETA +3 business days). We'll also need a network peering/VPC plan if they want dedicated peering for log sinks.

deploy-bot: TICKET-99901 created: "TideGate - provision eu/ca pinned pools, regional log sinks, optional KMS proxy"

keira_sales: Perfect. I'll propose two SOW options: A) Hosted pinned (no cross-border) + 22% uplift, 10bd lead + optional KMS proxy +5bd, B) Dedicated/private for full locality (4-6w, infra fee). I'll attach the attestation and the config snippet.

mohit_engineer: Config snippet to include in presales pack (short):

```
routing:
  mode: tenant_sticky
  primary: "eu-west-1"
  secondary: "ca-central-1"  # cold-standby
  failover: "none"  # options: none / weighted
kms:
  byo: true
  proxy_mode: true
logs:
  sink: regional
  telemetry_scope: "in-region-only"
```

keira_sales: Thanks everyone, will send SOW draft and security questionnaire answers to @ana_privsec. :+1:
